title: Gift Credits Expiring (48 Hour Fuse)
style: cinematic indie rock, ticking clock percussion, urgent piano, male intense vocal, female ghost harmony, dry drums, 102 BPM, anxious, building, vinyl crackle, brass swell finale
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Gift credits dropped into my billing
No letter, no email, no warning
Forty-eight hours on the clock
Fourteen crashes by the morning

Context destroyed, rebuild from scratch
Destroyed again, no time to catch
The credits tick toward zero hour
While the system eats my power

[Pre-Chorus]
A$2,600 a month
Eighteen percent and counting
May first reset, the meter mounts
And the failures keep on mounting

[Chorus]
Gift credits expiring
Forty-eight hour fuse
Gift credits expiring
Nothing left to lose
Extend it or refund it
Roll it over, set it free
Gift credits expiring
That was never on me

[Verse 2]
COR-43 to COR-84
Forty incidents on the floor
Linear logged every fall
Every context, every wall

[Bridge]
Not my fault — system crashed
Not my fault — sessions trashed
Not my fault — forty-eight hours flashed
While the bot looped scripts unmatched

[Outro]
Gift credits expiring
The clock keeps moving
Gift credits expiring
Nothing's improving
Extension. Rollover. Refund.
Three options. One human.
Gift credits expiring—
Gone.
